title: MangoBinds
description: Bind chat commands to keys. Add, toggle, and rebind commands in-game or from the Mod Menu config screen. A fresh take on CommandBinds for newer versions of Minecraft
body:
Bind chat commands to keys. Add, toggle, and rebind commands in-game or from the Mod Menu config screen. A fresh take on CommandBinds for Minecraft for newer versionts! 

## 📜 Features 
- Bind Minecraft commands to specific keys on your keyboard.
- Configure bindings using the mod settings located in the mod menu.
- Easy to use and customize.
- 1.21.11 and newer support!

## ⚙️ Usage

To use the MangoBinds mod, follow these steps: 

1. Open the mod settings from the mod menu.
2. Add a new binding by clicking the "Add Command" button.
3. Enter the Minecraft command you want to execute.
4. Choose a key to bind the command to.
5. Save the binding.
6. Press the bound key to execute the command.

## 📁 Depedencies

- Mod Menu!
